apparatus.basis: Greek ἐπειδή subordinator; visible suffix ⲁⲏ matches Lyc. spelling ⲉⲡⲉⲓⲁⲏ. Editor's brackets restore the prefix.
Editor's restoration of the copular pronoun introducing the predication 'he is X'; standard Coptic copula construction with ⲛ̄ⲧⲁϥ ⲡⲉ.
Editor's restoration completing the standard purpose-clause idiom ⲭⲉⲕⲁⲁⲥ 'in order that'; the ⲛ̄ links to the following object 'all the begettings.'
Editor's restoration completing ⲡⲉϥⲧⲱⲃⲉ 'his imprint/seal' (cf. ⲧⲱⲃⲉ in glossary); confirmed by the parallel use of 'imprint of seal' in the same enumeration (line 13).
Editor's restoration completing ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'the Light'; standard Manichaean phrase 'great Aeon of the Light' for the Land of Light.

notes.decision: Translated 'ensnare him.' The lexeme is uncertain. Tentatively read as Lyc. reflex of ⲥⲱⲱⲧ 'weave, plait, entangle' (Crum 369b) with 3sg.m. suffix, fitting the archonic-restraint context between 'draw out the light from him' and 'hinder him in his ascent.' Other candidates: ⲥⲱϩⲉ 'draw down/restrain' (but expects ⲍ in Lyc.); ⲥⲱⲧⲉ 'redeem' (semantically wrong here). Confidence low.

Translated 'imprint-figure of seal.' The noun ϩⲟⲩⲣ is obscure; possibly related to ϩⲟ 'face/image' or to a stamp-pattern noun. Context (paired with 'new character/χαρακτήρ') requires a noun meaning 'mold, type, stamp, exemplar.' The composite ϩⲟⲩⲣ-ⲛ̄-ⲧⲱⲃⲉ designates Adam as bearing a divinely-imprinted figure paralleling the Ambassador's icon. Confidence low.

Parsed as ⲟⲩⲛ̄-ⲁ-ⲟⲩⲱⲛⲍ̄ 'there shall be revealed' (existential + future + verbal noun). The doubled ⲟⲩ may reflect Lyc. orthographic redundancy; alternative parsing as ⲟⲩⲁ 'one (thing)' + ⲟⲩⲱⲛⲍ̄ does not fit syntax.

Translated as interrogative 'what.' Possibly Lyc. variant of ⲉⲩ/ⲁϣ 'what.' The full phrase ⲉⲱ ⲧⲉ ⲧⲍⲉ = 'what is the manner' opens Mani's exposition as a rhetorical-interrogative declaration about the Sun's fashioning. Standard Kephalaia opening pattern.

Translated 'stronghold' rather than 'dwelling-place.' The form ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲓⲟⲣⲉ with -ⲣⲉ ending matches the glossary entry ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲟⲣⲉ 'stronghold/fortress' (ⲙⲁⲛ-ϫⲱⲣⲉ 'place of strength') rather than ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲓⲟⲡⲉ 'dwelling.' The pairing 'gate of Life and stronghold of Peace' fits the Manichaean cosmographic image of the Sun as both threshold (gate) and fortified citadel of Peace.

The ⲭ̄ⲉ markers (with supralinear stroke) are decorative chapter-abbreviation symbols (= κεφάλαιον), used to bracket the new chapter title at line 25. Rendered as '§' to preserve the structural-divisional function without inventing English text.
